# Stimpunks.Love

> Queer without fear. Interdependent and here. Divergent and proud. Living out loud. Plucky pluralism, for human organisms. Becoming and belonging, with ribald songing.

A Stimpunks Foundation site, and the loud one. It has no single design system on purpose: the street is the system and the rooms refuse to share one. Through a gate in the wall there is a garden, with one bed for every site we publish and every bed linking out to it. The street has an edge at each end and they are not the same kind of edge: past the treeline there is a campground, for anybody who would rather not be on a street at all, and past the last streetlight the other way there is a road out of town, where the mystical and the after-dark keep premises. Two habits survive from our careful sites — attribution, which is a licence rather than a house style, and contrast, because clashing is not the same as illegible.

Every page carries an intensity dial with three settings. It defaults to whatever the visitor's device asks for and lets them turn it up past that; Gentle removes motion and sparkle and never removes content.

## The rooms, the garden through the gate, and the field at the end of the street

- [Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/): Queer without fear. Interdependent and here. Divergent and proud. Living out loud. One street, no two rooms alike, a garden through the gate in the wall, a campground past the treeline, and a dial that lets you decide how loud it gets. A Stimpunks Foundation site.
- [Danny the Street — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/danny-the-street.html): Where this street got its name. Danny the Street is a sentient street in DC Comics' Doom Patrol, created in 1990 by Grant Morrison and Richard Case, named after the drag performer Danny La Rue, hunted by an agency devoted to normalcy, and played on television as genderqueer. What Danny has been since, and which parts of Danny this site took.
- [Pink Pony Club — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/pink-pony-club.html): The dancefloor. Ten songs our own pages already credit, in one jukebox. Nothing plays until you press play — no autoplay, and nothing reaches YouTube before you ask for it.
- [The Chappell — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/the-chappell.html): A subroom off Pink Pony Club: thirteen Chappell Roan videos in a rhinestone chapel, and the whole playlist at the east end. Every label that plays one thing says how long before you press it, and nothing reaches YouTube until you do.
- [Club Chronic — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/club-chronic.html): Freaks to the front. A punk club on the street: the story of scenes that built their own doors, every playlist we keep, and a rack of records along the back wall. Nothing plays until you press play, and nothing in here strobes.
- [The Zine Table — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/zine-table.html): Xerox, staples, ransom note. The room where we get angry in ten point type — and the room that explains which two things stay careful even here.
- [The Zine Table, Issue #2: One Root, Two Rainbows — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/zine-issue-2.html): Seven lessons on neurodiversity and gender, photocopied down to one sheet. Distilled from our own library, with the course linked and the song left unprinted.
- [Hear Queer Here — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/hear-queer-here.html): Quantum queering: reading queerness and the physics of indeterminacy through each other. Nothing is fixed, bounded, or settled in advance of its relations.
- [Enid's Room — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/enids-room.html): Colorful goth. Black walls, technicolour everything else, and somewhere to sit when the glee runs out. The room for the one who doesn't match the house.
- [The Polaroid Wall — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/polaroids.html): How a photo gets onto Enid's wall, what we ask for, what we promise, and how it comes down again. The wall is empty on purpose until somebody sends one.
- [The Playhouse — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/playhouse.html): Everything is a button and every button yells. The glossary wearing a costume — and every toy is a real control that Tab reaches and a screen reader names.
- [The Arcade — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/arcade.html): Room seven: a grape carpet, a marquee, and cabinets standing on it. Walk up to one. Nothing in here has a timer, a score, a way to lose or a sound, and nothing in any of them is trying to beat you.
- [Quill Drift — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/quill-drift.html): A cabinet in the Arcade. Esmx the Porkypine walks a dark field and the loose quills drifting across it join their mane on contact. No timer, no lives, no score, nothing to defeat, and nothing you can throw.
- [Otterly Adorbs — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/otterly-adorbs.html): A cabinet in the Arcade. You steer an otter round a kelp bay: twirls, somersaults, dives, floating on your back, and fish at feeding time. Floating fills nothing up, on purpose. No timer, no lives, no score, nothing to defeat.
- [Penguin Pebbling — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/penguin-pebbling.html): A cabinet in the Arcade. A shore, some pebbles, and neighbours with nests. Carry something over and give it to somebody. Nothing is counted, nothing is owed back, and there is no wrong thing to give anybody.
- [The Latibulum — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/latibulum.html): A burrow of belonging for burnouts. Under the hill: a round door, a lamp, a wireless playing ocean waves, a television showing seated tai chi, and a shelf of things to do with a bodymind. Nothing counted, nothing loud, nothing plays until you press play.
- [The Jungle Room — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/jungle-room.html): A viewing room under a closed canopy. The nature live cams our own Watering Hole Hangs page puts on in the background — waterholes, otters, reefs, forests, butterflies, nests and whoever walks past — in that page's own groups and order. Nothing plays until you press play, and nothing here says how long it runs, because none of it ends.
- [The Den — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/the-den.html): Behind the Jungle Room, the other Jungle Room: Elvis Presley's den at Graceland — green shag, carved wood, a fieldstone waterfall — which in 1976 was turned into a recording studio. Sixteen songs cut in that carpet across two sessions, in the order they were recorded, and every one of them says how long it runs before you press it.
- [The Mopery — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/the-mopery.html): A dark academia library, reading room and parlour. Shelves of books that open to a note and a way to borrow them, one screen playing versions of Paint It Black, and a reading nook where The Raven can be set in any face on the street. Nothing plays until you press play.
- [The Oracle Deck — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/oracle-deck.html): Thirteen public domain engravings from the Metropolitan Museum's open collection, each with a question on the back. It asks and does not answer: no fortunes, no reversals, nothing about what is going to happen to you. The whole deck is on the page.
- [The Doomscroll — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/the-doomscroll.html): Public domain poems of doom and gloom, laid out as a feed of bad news, newest first by the date each was first published — on an actual scroll. Every poem is entire, every text names the printing it came from, and every author has been dead more than seventy years.
- [The Adventurer’s Guild — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/adventurers-guild.html): A job board in a manila room, on a street where nothing else is tidy. Each job sends you to a marker standing in one of the rooms; the marker gives you a code, and the code comes back here. Nothing is scored, nothing expires, every job carries hints and a give-me-the-answer way out, and the fanfare does whatever the dial says.
- [The Feed — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/the-feed.html): A split-flap arrivals board in a dark concourse, one wire per site, carrying the latest from stimpunks.org and every one of its sibling sites off their own RSS feeds. A title, a date and where it goes — never the words themselves. The board says the minute it was set, because a board is not the railway.
- [The Zibaldone — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/zibaldone.html): A commonplace book left open on a desk. Quotations copied out by hand for whatever state you are in, every one of them naming the printing it came from and how it was checked. Short quotations only, no song lyrics, and nothing here is ranked.
- [The Rabbit Hole — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/rabbit-hole.html): You meant to look up one thing. A shaft you fall down on purpose: rabbit holing as monotropic attention rather than a failure of discipline, seven recordings off our own glossary entry, six 1865 wood engravings, and a trail out. Nothing plays until you press play.
- [The Healing Checkpoint — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/healing-checkpoint.html): Room 429. A save room off the street with a spring in the floor and a bed nobody is charging you for: an appreciation of rest built out of our own Rest entry, the healing checkpoint as a place that asks nothing, and a Retry-After slip you can send somebody. Nothing here is counted and nothing is stored.
- [The Foundry — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/foundry.html): A type foundry on the street: a grey iron workshop where you can set your own words, or words out of The Playhouse, The Mopery and The Zibaldone, in any typeface this site holds. Size, leading, tracking, measure, weight, a real italic or a machine slant, four measured inks, and a proof you can print with the designer's name on it.
- [Your Room — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/your-room.html): An empty storefront on the street, with the keys in the door. One person from the community gets a page here, their own stylesheet, and their name on it.
- [The Pebble Board — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/pebble-board.html): A community noticeboard on the street. Our people bring each other songs, art, jokes, recipes and things worth keeping, and one edition at a time gets pinned up here. Nothing plays until you press play.
- [The Garden — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/the-garden.html): Through the gate in the wall: the knowledge garden, with one bed for every site we publish. What a knowledge garden is, how this one is tended, how to start one of your own, and the Garden Spider, whose best answer is an entrance.
- [The Campgrounds — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/campgrounds.html): Where the street runs out. A field past the treeline with numbered pitches on it, for the ones who would rather live on the edge of town. Nothing out here moves, at any setting.
- [Faery Yurt — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/faery-yurt.html): Helen's candlelit yurt in the campgrounds, pitched at the edge of the woods. Old books, fairy lights, a regulation nook, three animals with opinions, and a window that opens onto somewhere else entirely.
- [Swaying Sweetgrass — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/swaying-sweetgrass.html): Pitch 02 in the campgrounds. A meadow of sweetgrass left alone, with one natural-surface path a wheelchair can use running into a clearing with a fire pit in it. The story at the fire is Robin Wall Kimmerer in her own voice.
- [The Solarpunk Hermitage — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/solarpunk-hermitage.html): Pitch 03 in the campgrounds. A wood cabin on wheels bristling with solar panels, and the first room on this street lit by daylight. A cave to read in, a campfire to watch from, a watering hole to make things at.
- [The Outskirts — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/the-outskirts.html): It's always dark in The Outskirts. The road past the last streetlight, where the mystical and the eldritch keep their own hours: hand-painted signs standing in the weeds, and only as much of them as the headlights reach.
- [Black Leather Lagoon — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/black-leather-lagoon.html): It's always Halloween at the Lagoon. A drive-in screen standing in black water at the edge of town, an appreciation of The Cramps, our Halloween playlist and a rack of their records on posts. Nothing plays until you press play, and nothing here flickers.
- [Sithen — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/sithen.html): A fairy fort seen from the outside, under a full moon. The rules nobody will say out loud, the ring that a whole country declines to plough, and a door this room does not open.
- [Covenstead — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/covenstead.html): A meeting place with the door shut and several lamps that do not match. Counsel that stayed counsel, a law the tradition itself argues about, and the practice of watching your own first thoughts. Nobody is initiated.
- [Liner Notes — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/liner-notes.html): Who made this noise. Every song, typeface, quotation and borrowed name on this street, credited to the person it belongs to.
- [Changelog — Stimpunks.Love](https://stimpunks.love/changelog.html): What changed on the street, and when. Every Stimpunks site publishes one of these.
